mapper.insert: INSERT INTO training_task_execution (task_id, user_id, content_id, attempt_no, idempotency_key, status, started_at, finished_at, duration_seconds, score, result_data, error_message) VALUES (#{taskId}, #{userId}, #{contentId}, #{attemptNo}, #{idempotencyKey}, #{status}, #{startedAt}, #{finishedAt}, #{durationSeconds}, #{score}, #{resultData}, #{errorMessage})
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(MAX(attempt_no), 0) FROM training_task_execution WHERE task_id = #{taskId}
mapper.update: UPDATE training_task_execution SET status = #{execution.status}, finished_at = #{execution.finishedAt}, duration_seconds = #{execution.durationSeconds}, score = #{execution.score}, result_data = #{execution.resultData}, error_message = #{execution.errorMessage}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{execution.id} AND status = #{expectedStatus}
